attack_techniques: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Logs (T1562.008)
attackers_goals: Evade detection by limiting collected data.
description: A cloud trail logging has been stopped, which indicates that AWS API calls are not recorded in that trail.
investigative_actions: Verify whether the identity attempted to stop trail logging. Determine if additional trails continue to log activity.
